channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tabata brinca sobre foto de João Campos com Lula: “Namorado dele”
item.description: Deputy Tabata Amaral made a joking post comparing her husband João Campos’ meeting with President Lula to a 'boyfriend meeting his boyfriend'. The encounter took place during the PSB National Convention in Brasília, where Lula reaffirmed his public support for Campos’ gubernatorial campaign in Pernambuco.

item.title: O que Lula falou sobre o Paraguai, e quem está certo sobre a história?
item.description: Lula made remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance (1864-1870) that Paraguay considered offensive, prompting the summoning of Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations. Paraguay viewed the comments as a historical distortion and lack of respect, while Lula's defenders say he was attempting to contextualize past regional conflicts. The episode revived historical tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo é escolhido como coordenador da campanha de Caiado
item.description: The campaign of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced on Thursday (July 30) that former minister Aldo Rebelo will serve as coordinator of his presidential bid. Rebelo, a former federal deputy and minister in the Lula and Dilma governments, will oversee the campaign's political articulation following a meeting with PSD leadership in São Paulo.

item.title: Renan Santos é candidato que mais impulsiona anúncios contra Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nas redes
item.description: Renan Santos, the candidate from the Missão party, spent the most on targeted ads against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on social media, among those positioning themselves as a third way in the 2026 presidential race. His focus on direct attacks against these two figures reflects a strategy of ideological contrast to gain visibility.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra IAs ligadas à família Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation filed a representation with the TSE against a network of anonymous Instagram profiles using AI to produce offensive content against President Lula, with coordinated sharing by Flávio Bolsonaro and PL congressmen. The scheme involves over 30 profiles replicating AI-generated videos, including one depicting Lula holding a bag of money and wearing a shirt provocative toward Trump, reaching over 10 million people and generating profit through AI course sales and cryptocurrency donations.

item.title: Caiado minimiza falta de Tarcísio em convenção do PSD: "Independência"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado downplayed the absence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas at the PSD convention, emphasizing Tarcísio's independence and affirming that the PSD's support for his candidacy is clear, with a campaign structure already in place. He noted that Tarcísio's support for Flávio Bolsonaro is not unprecedented in Brazilian politics and maintained a good personal relationship with the governor. The 'pure-blood' Caiado-Kassab ticket aims to position itself as a third way between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Paraguai convoca embaixador do Brasil após fala de Lula sobre guerra
item.description: Paraguay summoned Brazil's ambassador in Asunción for explanations following President Lula's remarks about the Paraguayan War. Foreign Minister Rubén Ramírez Lezcano announced the move, indicating that Lula and Paraguayan President Santiago Peña will engage in dialogue on the matter.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro troca de novo comando da comunicação e anuncia Duda Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign announced a new change in its communications structure, replacing the previous leadership with Duda Lima. The adjustment was confirmed by campaign general coordinator Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) in a statement released on Thursday, the 30th.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio teria dificuldades para vencer no segundo turno
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would face difficulties winning a potential runoff in the 2026 elections. He emphasized his administrative experience as a competitive advantage. The comment was made during a press conference in São Paulo.

item.title: É #FAKE que Moraes disse que 'nem Trump' poderá visitar Bolsonaro
item.description: It is #FAKE that Minister Alexandre de Moraes said 'not even Trump' could visit Bolsonaro. The video circulating on social media, featuring AI-generated narration, falsely attributes statements to the STF minister claiming Trump, Milei, or others cannot meet Bolsonaro, and that Bolsonaro is ready to return to Papudinha with doubled security. The STF's press office denied the allegations, stating no such statements were made.

item.title: Flávio troca marqueteiros e convida Duda Lima para assumir campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has invited political marketer Duda Lima to lead the communications team for his 2026 presidential campaign. Lima, with over 20 years of experience, previously managed Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign and Ricardo Nunes’ victorious São Paulo mayoral race. The shift follows the departure of Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer, whose contributions were praised by the campaign.

item.title: Kassio vai relatar ação do PT sobre IA para desinformação contra Lula
item.description: TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has been assigned as rapporteur in a case filed by the PT, PV, and PCdoB coalition, accusing PL politicians — including Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and deputies Mario Frias, Gustavo Gayer, Gilvan da Federal, and pre-candidate André Marinho — of using AI and anonymous profiles on Instagram and TikTok to spread disinformation against Lula. The complaint alleges coordinated inauthentic behavior (astroturfing) via Instagram’s 'collab' feature, offensive jingles on TikTok, and the amplification of synthetic content to reach over 10 million people.

item.title: Veja as diferenças de Lula e Flávio nas pesquisas estaduais de Rio, SP, MG e mais 7 estados
item.description: The Quaest polls across ten Brazilian states show Lula leading in Minas Gerais, Pernambuco, Bahia, Ceará, Pará, and São Paulo (though narrowly), while Flávio Bolsonaro leads in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, and Goiás. Lula’s largest leads are in Pernambuco and Ceará (34 and 37 points), while Flávio’s strongest advantage is in Paraná (18 points). The data reflects a polarized race with significant regional variation.

item.title: Transparência Internacional lança agenda com 40 propostas de combate à corrupção para Estados
item.description: Transparency International-Brazil launched an agenda with 40 anti-corruption proposals for state governments, effective 2027–2030. The recommendations span seven thematic axes, including open data, anti-corruption mechanisms, parliamentary amendments, public works, internal control agencies, social participation, and public security, highlighting state portals for tracking obras and emendas, whistleblower protection, and the creation of State Transparency and Anti-Corruption Councils.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro troca de marqueteiro pela segunda vez em dois meses
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, has changed campaign managers for the second time in two months, replacing Eduardo Fischer with Duda Lima — the same strategist who led Jair Bolsonaro's defeated 2022 campaign. The move reflects growing turmoil in his bid, plagued by the Master case, a feud with his stepmother, ties to Trump's tariff policies, lack of a running mate, and failure to secure Centrão party support.

item.title: Flávio troca equipe e contrata marqueteiro da campanha de Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Duda Lima, the strategist behind Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 reelection campaign, has been hired to lead Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential bid for 2026. The news is exclusive and requires a subscription for full access.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio troca marqueteiro pela segunda vez após crises: Duda Lima assume posto
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign replaced its communications team for the second time in two months, dismissing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer and hiring Duda Lima, who led Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign and is allied with PL president Valdemar Costa Neto. The move was announced by campaign coordinator Senator Rogério Marinho following criticism over the team's slow response to crises involving Michelle Bolsonaro and the 'Dark Horse' scandal.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro troca comando da comunicação pela 2ª vez e anuncia Duda Lima como marqueteiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign announced its second change in communications leadership, replacing Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fischer with Duda Lima, a publicist linked to Valdemar Costa Neto and former strategist for Jair Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign and Ricardo Nunes' victorious 2024 São Paulo mayoral bid. The shift follows the party's convention, which featured an AI-generated video simulating the former president, and comes amid recent controversies. Lima, who had declared retirement from campaign work in 2024, returns despite previously stating he would no longer sign on to campaigns.

item.title: Kataguiri troca farpas com Eduardo Bolsonaro: “Frouxo”
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) responded to threats from Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP), who said he would return to Brazil to 'beat up' the lawmaker, following Kataguiri's comments in a podcast. Kataguiri labeled Bolsonaro as 'weak' in retaliation, escalating the conflict between the two opposing politicians.

item.title: Flávio troca marketing da campanha e convoca Duda Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign announced a change in its marketing leadership on Thursday, with the departure of publicists Alexandre Oltramari and Eduardo Fisher and the hiring of Duda Lima, who previously worked on Ricardo Nunes' victorious 2024 campaign. The move aims to strengthen the candidate's communication strategy.

item.title: Sem entusiasmo, Lula sinaliza que finalmente vai se reunir com Alcolumbre
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signaled he will meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil) next week, after the parliamentary recess ends. The decision follows renewed appeals for dialogue between the two leaders, although Lula showed little enthusiasm for the meeting. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: A acusação do governo Lula contra Trump na OMC
item.description: The Lula government accuses the Trump administration of violating WTO commitments by imposing additional tariffs of 25% and 12.5% on Brazilian goods, claiming these measures breach GATT and the WTO dispute settlement mechanism. The tariffs were based on USTR Section 301 investigations that labeled Brazilian practices in digital trade, intellectual property, ethanol, and forced labor as 'unfair' or 'discriminatory'. Brazil has formally requested consultations at the WTO to challenge these unilateral U.S. actions.

item.title: Tarcísio vai encontrar uma vice para Flávio?
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) is coordinating Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) campaign in the state and working to define a presidential ticket with former President Jair Bolsonaro. He contacted PP national president Ciro Nogueira to secure Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) as the vice-presidential candidate, aiming to strengthen the alliance between parties.

item.title: 'Motoboy do Lula' aciona Ministério Público do Trabalho contra práticas da Keeta
item.description: Junior Freitas, a delivery worker and pre-candidate for state deputy in São Paulo from PSOL, known as 'Lula's delivery guy', filed a complaint with the Labor Public Ministry against practices by the company Keeta. He is a leader of the Movement of Workers Without Rights and participated in the federal working group to regulate delivery workers, as well as attended the launch of the MOVE Brasil credit program alongside President Lula.

item.title: Desaprovação a Lula em MG chega a 54%, diz Real Time Big Data
item.description: Real Time Big Data revealed that 54% of voters in Minas Gerais disapprove of Lula's government, while 46% approve, based on a survey conducted between July 25 and 29, 2026. As the second-largest electoral college in Brazil, Minas Gerais holds decisive weight in the 2026 presidential election. Among respondents, 42% rated the administration as poor or terrible, 31% as good or excellent, and 23% as regular.

item.title: Janja diz que quis deixar Brasília após críticas por fala a Xi Jinping
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva said she considered withdrawing from public life after being criticized by the press for mentioning, during a meeting with Xi Jinping in May 2025, the case of an 8-year-old girl who died from participating in the 'deodorant challenge' on TikTok. She said the media backlash made her think of leaving Brasília for São Paulo, but reiterated the need to regulate digital platforms, stating that algorithms monetize hate speech against women.

item.title: “Ainda bem que Lula disse que não iria interferir nas investigações sobre Lulinha”
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) criticized the Federal Police's decision to activate the Attorney General's Office against Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, stating he had never seen anything like it in his 22 years as a judge. He linked the move to President Lula's promise not to interfere in investigations involving his son, Lulinha, suggesting the PF's action contradicts that pledge.

item.title: PT aposta em vitórias em Ceará, Bahia e Rio para compensar possível derrota no primeiro turno em SP
item.description: The PT is assessing that, given the risk of Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) winning in the first round in São Paulo, it is necessary to strengthen candidacies allied to President Lula in other key states such as Ceará, Bahia, and Rio de Janeiro to offset a possible electoral defeat in SP. The strategy aims to maintain national influence through regional victories, even if the Paulista stronghold cannot be reversed.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Flávio Bolsonaro, Mario Frias e Gayer por rede de vídeos com IA contra Lula
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) filed a complaint with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro, Mario Frias, Gustavo Gayer, Gilvan da Federal, André Marinho and anonymous profiles over an alleged coordinated network using AI to produce and disseminate offensive videos against Lula and allies, monetized through AI courses, PIX and cryptocurrencies. The action claims use of Instagram 'collab', TikTok soundtracks and amplification by public figures to dominate discourse and damage political image, citing Flávio Bolsonaro’s post with 1 million views.

item.title: Traição em Minas coroa fracasso do projeto político de Zema na pré-campanha
item.description: Romeu Zema's 2026 presidential project suffered a major setback with the defection of former secretary Marcelo Aro, who is expected to support Flávio Bolsonaro, leaving Mateus Simões without backing from major parties in Minas Gerais. With Novo excluded from electoral TV time due to failing the electoral threshold, Zema faces national isolation and weak vote-transfer capacity, undermining his goal of boosting Novo candidates in the legislature.

item.title: Gracinha Caiado lidera disputa pelo Senado em GO, diz Genial/Quaest
item.description: Gracinha Caiado (União Brasil) leads the Senate race in Goiás with 20% voter intention, according to a Genial/Quaest poll released on July 31, 2026. She is followed by Vanderlan Cardoso (PSD) at 10%, technically tied with Zacharias Calil (MDB), Gustavo Gayer (PL), and Gustavo Mendanha (PRD). The survey interviewed 1,104 voters from July 24–28, with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula empatam em rejeição em Minas Gerais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are technically tied in rejection rates in Minas Gerais, with 51% and 49% of voters saying they would not vote for them, respectively, according to a Real Time Big Data survey. The 2-point margin of error means the difference falls within statistical noise, making their rejection levels effectively equivalent. The poll, conducted July 25–29 with 2,000 voters and registered with the TSE under BR-00968/2026, cost R$30,000 and was self-funded.

item.title: Na OMC, governo Lula acusa EUA de desrespeitar regras comerciais
item.description: The Brazilian government accused the United States of violating WTO rules by imposing 37.5% tariffs on Brazilian products under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act, claiming the measures are inconsistent with GATT 1994 and requesting consultations at the WTO. The complaint initiates the WTO dispute settlement process, but analysts note that due to the paralysis of the Appellate Body since 2019—caused by U.S. blockages of appointments—the process may not yield immediate practical effects.

item.title: Lula brinca sobre “derrubar sistema” após queda de energia no Planalto
item.description: During the sanctioning ceremony of a law increasing funding for Funapol, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva joked about a power outage at the Palácio do Planalto, saying that if he knew it was so easy to 'bring down the system,' he would have done it himself. Lula stated the bill was drafted by the Ministries of Justice, Planning, and Finance—not the PF or Congress—and said he would forward the request from the Federal Police Confederations to support PEC 24/2024, which addresses distortions in the 2019 pension reform, to Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães.

item.title: Aposta de Raquel Lyra em investigado por emendas gera crise em PE
item.description: Governor Raquel Lyra (PSB) is pushing to nominate Miguel Coelho (União Brasil), the former mayor of Petrolina under investigation in Operation Vassalos for alleged diversion of parliamentary amendments, as her Senate candidate. This risks breaking the União Brasil-PP federation, which refuses to support a ticket with an investigated figure, potentially shifting support to João Campos (PSB). Lyra also backs Túlio Gadelha (PSD) as an alternative Senate candidate.

item.title: Os 'Bolsonaros de IA' que fazem campanha até contra Flávio nas redes sociais nesta eleição
item.description: Supporters of Jair Bolsonaro are using AI-generated deepfakes to create fake videos of the former president endorsing his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential campaign, despite Bolsonaro being ineligible and barred from political activity. These videos, spreading on TikTok, simulate pleas for votes and even a false ‘release order’ allowing candidacy, exploiting loyalist sentiment. While Flávio’s campaign used a labeled AI simulation at his convention, the viral content by supporters often omits this disclaimer, amplifying misinformation.

item.title: CBAt notifica ex-velocista olímpico por uso de patrocínio da Caixa em posts com Bolsonaro e Tarcísio
item.description: The Brazilian Athletics Confederation (CBAt) sent an extrajudicial notice to former Olympic sprinter André Domingos, head of the André Domingos – Velozes em Ação association, for using Caixa sponsorship in social media posts that included political expressions alongside Jair Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas. CBAt claims he violated the terms of the 'Ídolos do Atletismo Loterias Caixa' program by mixing institutional promotion with partisan content, giving him 48 hours to submit a defense.

item.title: Governo defende multilateralismo e OMC em evento do agro
item.description: Minister Márcio Elias Rosa (MDIC) defended multilateralism and the WTO as essential in the global scenario, emphasizing that Brazil, under President Lula’s guidance, remains active in trade negotiations despite international impasses. Speaking at the Outlook Agro Brasil event, he rejected claims that Brazilian agribusiness relies on illegal deforestation, citing 50% deforestation reduction in the Amazon, 36% in the Cerrado, and 63% in the Pantanal over the last three years, and affirmed the country maintains external competitiveness through rigorous environmental commitments. The event also featured Ministers André de Paula (Agriculture) and Édipo Araújo (Fisheries), who announced the opening of 19 new international markets for national aquaculture and expanded credit lines.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que destina verba das bets ao fundo da PF
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed into law a measure allocating part of the revenue from fixed-odds sports betting (bets) to the Funapol fund, which finances the Federal Police’s operations, along with up to R$200 million in unrestricted Treasury funds for 2026. Originating from MP 1.348/2026, the initiative was coordinated by the ministries of Justice, Planning, and Finance, aiming to strengthen efforts against organized crime and improve conditions for federal police officers.

item.title: Peña liga para Lula e Paraguai convoca embaixador brasileiro
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña spoke by phone with Brazilian President Lula after Lula claimed Paraguay 'invaded' Brazil in the Paraguayan War (1864-1870). Paraguay summoned Brazil's ambassador for an official note and scheduled a meeting for July 31, involving Vice President Pedro Alliana and foreign ministry officials. Lula's remarks were condemned as a historical distortion by Paraguayan authorities, including Congress and the vice president, who demand mutual respect and the return of historical artifacts.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que destina parte da arrecadação das bets para a Polícia Federal
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a law allocating up to 3% of sports betting (bets) revenue to the Federal Police’s funding fund (Funapol). The allocation will be phased in: 1% in 2026, 2% in 2027, and 3% from 2028 onward, redirecting funds previously earmarked for social security. The Funapol will also receive R$200 million from the federal government in 2026, with funds usable for PF operations and police health care.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 59% e aprovado por 35% em GO, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula has a 35% approval rating and 59% disapproval in Goiás, according to a Genial/Quaest poll from July 2026. Government evaluation shows 47% rating the administration as 'bad' or 'terrible', compared to 27% who see it as 'excellent' or 'good'. The survey interviewed 1,104 voters between July 24–28, with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Entre recuos e restrições, governo Lula muda rotina com o defeso eleitoral
item.description: The Lula government adjusted its routine following the start of the electoral blackout on July 4, modifying institutional communications to avoid using state resources for electoral benefit, including removing official branding from public materials, shifting Lula’s speeches to his personal YouTube channel, and allowing ministers to resume state visits and interviews with careful rhetoric. EBC reversed a broad content block and began restoring previously restricted materials after consulting the TSE to safeguard journalistic content. The Secom issued an internal guide stating that public service information may be shared, provided it does not include praise of the administration.

item.title: Com fim da Copa, eleições dominam debate nas redes sociais, mostra estudo
item.description: The Democracia em Xeque Institute reports that after the World Cup ended, the presidential campaign dominated social media debate, with 'national politics' accounting for 26% of monitored posts and 25% of interactions between July 21–27. The PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy was the most discussed event, generating nearly 46 million interactions, driven by Javier Milei’s incendiary remarks against Lula and Alexandre de Moraes, which were amplified by the far right and used to revive false claims about Brazil’s electronic voting machines.

item.title: Nova lei prevê reforço na divulgação de telefone para denúncias de violência contra mulher
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.478/26, which obliges public authorities to disseminate the Ligue 180 hotline for reporting violence against women in high-traffic public and private spaces. The law, published in the Official Gazette, stems from Bill 5465/16 by Deputy Laura Carneiro (PSD-RJ). Ligue 180, established in 2005, remains the primary channel for accessing public services to combat gender-based violence.

item.title: Sem novos ataques de Milei, integrantes do Itamaraty avaliam que 'tendência' é embaixador brasileiro retornar a Buenos Aires
item.description: Brazilian Foreign Ministry officials assess that, absent new attacks by Javier Milei, the tendency is for Ambassador Júlio Bitelli to return to Buenos Aires, though they caution that a few more days are needed to confirm the stability of Argentine signals. Bitelli is currently in Brasília and has met with Chancellor Mauro Vieira and President Lula to discuss bilateral tensions. Argentine Chancellor Pablo Quirno denied a rupture with Brazil, emphasizing Argentina’s intent to de-escalate the diplomatic crisis.

item.title: TSE desidrata portaria sobre planos de conformidade das plataformas digitais
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques softened the initial draft of the digital platforms compliance plan regulation for the 2026 elections, partially accommodating company requests by extending deadlines for proposal submission (to August 16) and responses to electoral diligences (10 days, extendable by up to five). Core requirements remain, including the mandate for platforms with over 5 million monthly active users in Brazil to submit compliance plans, and the authority to impose direct regulatory supervision if plans are not delivered on time.

item.title: Ex-secretário rompe com grupo de Zema e articula candidatura própria ao governo de MG
item.description: Former Minas Gerais Chief of Staff Marcelo Aro (PP) broke with Governor Romeu Zema Zema and is now articulating his own candidacy for state government rejecting the inclusion of Carlos Viana on the major ticket. The decision came after Republicans withdrew Cleitinho Azevedo as their Senate candidate, opening space for Aro to seek support from Republicans, PL, Union and PP. Aro indicated his candidacy depends on Cleitinho’s final decision and that, with PL backing, he could become Flávio Bolsonaro’s electoral base in Minas Gerais.

item.title: ‘Pix Pensão’: o que muda com nova lei que autoriza débito direto na conta
item.description: President Lula signed into law the 'Pix Pension' system, which mandates automatic debit payments for child support to reduce delinquency. Financial institutions must dedcourt-ordered amounts from the payer's account and notify authorities of insufficient funds, enabling asset seizure. He also approved a law requiring widespread publicity of the Ligue 180 hotline for women in high-traffic public spaces.

item.title: Caiado lidera no 2º turno contra Lula em GO, diz Genial/Quaest
item.description: Genial/Quaest poll shows Ronaldo Caiado leading in a hypothetical second-round presidential matchup against Lula in Goiás with 67% voter intention, compared to Lula’s 23%. In the first round, Caiado and Flávio Bolsonaro are technically tied at 33% and 27%, respectively. Lula is the most rejected candidate in Goiás, with 64% rejection among those familiar with him.
